mapper.sql: action_id, action_type, employee_id, source_type, source_business_id, before_snapshot_json, after_snapshot_json, effective_date, actual_confirm_time, business_status, risk_level, risk_codes_json, risk_detail, risk_confirmation_json, historical_reason, request_id, version, operator_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_ip, operator_user_agent, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into sys_hr_lifecycle_action ( action_type, employee_id, source_type, source_business_id, before_snapshot_json, after_snapshot_json, effective_date, actual_confirm_time, business_status, risk_level, risk_codes_json, risk_detail, risk_confirmation_json, historical_reason, request_id, version, operator_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_ip, operator_user_agent, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{actionType}, #{employeeId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceBusinessId}, #{beforeSnapshotJson}, #{afterSnapshotJson}, #{effectiveDate}, #{actualConfirmTime}, #{businessStatus}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskCodesJson}, #{riskDetail}, #{riskConfirmationJson}, #{historicalReason}, #{requestId}, #{version}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorIp}, #{operatorUserAgent}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update

select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action where employee_id = #{employeeId} and source_type = 'HR_RENEWAL' and source_business_id = #{sourceBusinessId} and action_type in ('RENEWAL_DECISION', 'RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_DECLINED') order by action_id asc for update
select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action where employee_id = #{employeeId} and action_type = 'TRANSFER_CONFIRMED' and effective_date = #{effectiveDate} order by action_id asc for update
select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action where employee_id = #{employeeId} and action_type = 'OFFBOARD_CONFIRMED' and effective_date = #{effectiveDate} order by action_id asc for update

select from sys_hr_lifecycle_action a where ( ( a.business_status = 'CONFIRMED' and a.action_type in ( 'ONBOARD_CONFIRMED', 'REGULARIZATION_CONFIRMED', 'TRANSFER_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'OFFBOARD_CONFIRMED' ) ) or ( a.action_type = 'RENEWAL_DECLINED' and a.business_status = 'DECLINED' ) ) and not exists ( select 1 from sys_hr_sign_event_outbox o where o.action_id = a.action_id and o.event_version = a.version ) order by a.action_id asc limit #{limit}
